results.title: Zongo Health Campaign screens over 110 Mamobi residents
results.description: More than 110 residents of Mamobi in Accra have benefited from free health screenings under the second edition of the Zongo Health Campaign, which identified three participants with breast lumps, three HIV-positive results and several cases of elevated blood sugar.
